# anthropic_rate_limits (Data Source)

Lists the organization's rate-limit groups and their organization-level limits through the Admin API, with optional filters by group type and model. Use an entry's `id` as the `rate_limit_id` of `anthropic_workspace_rate_limit`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_rate_limits" "model_groups" {
  group_type = "model_group"
}

output "model_group_rate_limit_ids" {
  value = {
    for rate_limit in data.anthropic_rate_limits.model_groups.rate_limits :
    rate_limit.display_name => rate_limit.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `group_type` (String) Return only the groups of this type. The API documents `model_group`, `batch`, `token_count`, `files`, `skills` and `web_search`. The API returns no groups for `token_count`, `files` and `skills`.
- `model` (String) Return only the group that contains this model. Accepts a full model name or an alias, for example `claude-haiku-4-5`. The read fails when no group of the organization contains the model.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, derived from the configured filters.
- `rate_limits` (Attributes List) The matching rate-limit entries, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limits))

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limits`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name of a `model_group`, for example `Claude Haiku 4.x`. Null for other group types.
- `group_id` (String) ID of the group (`rlg_...`).
- `group_type` (String) Type of the group, for example `model_group`, `batch` or `web_search`.
- `id` (String) ID of the rate-limit entry (`rlt_...`). This is the `rate_limit_id` of `anthropic_workspace_rate_limit`. It differs between organizations.
- `limits` (Map of Number) The organization's limit for each limiter type of the group, keyed by limiter type.
- `models` (List of String) The models in the group. Null for groups that are not model groups.
